posts.title: Sardiyon ki meethi roti
posts.caption:
Sardiyon ki subah, gur wali meethi roti.

Jaggery loves to stick and burn. On the Tawaana tawa it caramelises, turns golden, and lifts right off with a wooden spatula.

A few drops of ghee, medium flame, one flip.

Super lightweight iron with a PFOA-free granite non-stick coating. tawaana.com

posts.title: Lahori fish fry season
posts.caption:
Sardi aayi, fish fry season bhi.

The hardest part of frying fish at home is the flip. On the Tawaana fry pan the masala crust stays on the fish, not on the pan.

Medium flame, wooden spatula, one turn.

Nimbu aur chutney ke saath. tawaana.com

posts.title: 3 winter evening ideas
posts.caption:

2. Anda shami burger in the fry pan
3. Makai ki roti on the tawa

Medium flame, a few drops of oil, and everything lifts right off.

Save this for the next cold evening. tawaana.com

posts.title: Hang it, show it
posts.caption:
Cabinet full? Put them on the wall.

Every Tawaana tawa, fry pan and hot plate has a wooden handle with a hanging loop.

Hanging keeps the non-stick surface from getting scratched by other pans, and saves space too.

Just dry it fully before you hang it. tawaana.com

posts.title: Sunday tikka night
posts.caption:
Sunday ka plan: tikka boti, ghar pe.

The Tawaana hot plate gives you a wide, flat surface with even heat, so every piece chars the same.

Turn them with a wooden spatula and they lift clean, masala and all.

Naan, pyaz, chutney. Sab tayyar. tawaana.com
